jobs.title: Frontend Engineer
jobs.description:
Summary
  
  
The people here at Apple don't just build products—they craft the kind of wonder that has revolutionized entire industries. It's the diversity of those people and their ideas that encourage the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it! Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization. IS&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS&T makes the impossible feel effortless.Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here. Customer Systems is part of IS&T and drives the technology behind Apple's customer support experience — from contact center operations to the software powering the iconic Genius Bar. The team also builds and operates AppleCare's online support platform, which handles 6 billion visits per year, delivering seamless, high-quality support to Apple customers around the globe.
  
  
Description
  
  
Build and maintain scalable, high-performance web applications that deliver seamless and intuitive user experiences. Collaborate with cross-functional teams including designers, product managers, and backend engineers to translate product requirements and designs into responsive, accessible, and user-centric interfaces. Write clean, modular, maintainable, and reusable code using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, and modern frontend frameworks such as Vue, Angular, React. Contribute to frontend architecture and engineering best practices while ensuring applications meet performance, accessibility, security, and cross-browser compatibility standards. You will own frontend features end-to-end, from understanding requirements and implementing solutions to testing, debugging, deployment, and production support. You will also participate in code reviews, identify opportunities for improving application performance and reliability, and stay current with evolving web technologies and development practices.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications  
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 4+ years of professional experience in frontend/web application development.
* Hands-on experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
* Experience with modern frontend frameworks, such as Vue, Angular, React
* Experience building responsive, accessible, and user-centric web applications

  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications  
  
  

* Experience developing reusable UI components and implementing frontend design patterns
* Experience integrating RESTful APIs and working with backend services.
* Experience with frontend state management frameworks such as Redux or equivalent
* Familiarity with frontend build and development tools such as Webpack, Rush, ESLint, and related tooling
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated frontend build and deployment processes.
* Experience with web performance monitoring, profiling, and optimization.
* Experience with modern testing frameworks and tools such as Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress, or Playwright.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

You enjoy shaping the future of product innovation as a core leader, driving value for customers, guiding successful launches, and exceeding expectations. Join our dynamic team and make a meaningful impact by delivering high-quality products that resonate with clients.

As a Product Manager in Consumer and community banking, you are an integral part of the team that innovates new product offerings and leads the end-to-end product life cycle. As a core leader, you are responsible for acting as the voice of the customer and developing profitable products that provide customer value. Utilizing your deep understanding of how to get a product off the ground, you guide the successful launch of products, gather crucial feedback, and ensure top-tier client experiences. With a strong commitment to scalability, resiliency, and stability, you collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality products that exceed customer expectations.

**Job responsibilities**

* Define and execute product strategy, roadmap, and priorities for enterprise data platform capabilities.
* Partner with engineering teams to deliver scalable, reliable, and secure data solutions that support business, analytics, and AI use cases.
* Gather customer and stakeholder feedback to identify platform enhancements, emerging needs, and innovation opportunities.
* Create and manage product backlogs, requirements, and success metrics.
* Drive adoption of modern data engineering practices and cloud-native platform capabilities.
* Collaborate with data scientists, architects, engineers, and business stakeholders to ensure data platforms support AI and machine learning workloads.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends to inform product strategy and investment decisions & Define measurable business outcomes and monitor product performance against established objectives.
* Communicate product vision, roadmap progress, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership & Support planning, prioritization, and execution of platform modernization initiatives.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* 5+ years of experience or equivalent expertise in in Product Management, Technology, Data Platforms, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* Strong understanding of cloud computing concepts and modern platform architectures & Proven experience delivering enterprise-scale technology or data platform products.
* Experience working with large-scale data processing, data integration, analytics, or data platform solutions.
* Familiarity with modern data engineering technologies such as Spark, PySpark, Databricks, or similar distributed processing frameworks.
* Experience with enterprise data platforms, data lakes, metadata management, or data governance solutions.
* Understanding of machine learning concepts and AI-enabled business capabilities & Experience supporting products, platforms, or solutions used for analytics, machine learning, or generative AI workloads.
* Ability to define product requirements that enable AI-ready data assets, model development, or data-driven decision makin & Familiarity with modern AI ecosystem concepts such as MLOps, feature engineering, model lifecycle management, or AI governance.
* Experience partnering with engineering and data science teams to deliver AI-enabled capabilities & Knowledge of Generative AI, Agentic AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), or related AI technologies.

  
  
  
**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  
  
**ABOUT THE TEAM**  
  
  

Our Consumer & Community Banking division serves our Chase customers through a range of financial services, including personal banking, credit cards, mortgages, auto financing, investment advice, small business loans and payment processing. We're proud to lead the U.S. in credit card sales and deposit growth and have the most-used digital solutions – all while ranking first in customer satisfaction.

  

The CCB Data & Analytics team responsibly leverages data across Chase to build competitive advantages for the businesses while providing value and protection for customers. The team encompasses a variety of disciplines from data governance and strategy to reporting, data science and machine learning. We have a strong partnership with Technology, which provides cutting edge data and analytics infrastructure. The team powers Chase with insights to create the best customer and business outcomes.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Agent Development
jobs.description:
Summary
  
  
Apple is where individual imaginations gather together, committing to the values that lead to great work. Every new product we build, service we create, or Apple Store experience we deliver is the result of us making each other’s ideas stronger. That happens because every one of us shares a belief that we can make something wonderful and share it with the world, changing lives for the better. It’s the diversity of our people and their thinking that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do. When we bring everybody in, we can do the best work of our lives. Here, you’ll do more than join something — you’ll add something. There are countless ways you can contribute here, from working on apple.com to software for digital & physical Apple Stores, from software for Apple Care to Apple-wide systems for identity, operations, recruiting, and people management, from software for Apple data centers to Apple-wide data processing & AI/ML systems. Apple's IS&T team builds the tools, platforms, and services that power the people who build Apple. Our Customer Systems group is reimagining how Apple engineers work through intelligent, autonomous systems — and we're looking for an Agentic AI Developer to help lead that effort.
  
  
Description
  
  
We are looking for a talented Agentic AI Developer to join Apple's IS&T Customer Systems team. In this role, you will design, build, and operate intelligent autonomous agent systems end-to-end — both client-side and server-side. You will architect agents that reason, plan, remember, and act reliably across long-running workflows, with deep attention to memory design, multi-agent orchestration, observability, and maintainability. This is a deeply technical engineering role with a high bar for production quality. You will own the full lifecycle of agentic systems: from agent architecture and memory design, to tool integration, observability, and safe deployment. While the primary focus is agent engineering, a solid understanding of the Java tech stack, React, and TypeScript is also important, as you will work across both server-side and client-side surfaces. You will collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, and platform teams across Apple to bring AI capabilities into the developer tools our teams depend on every day.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications  
  
  

* 4+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 2 years focused on AI/ML systems, LLM integrations, or autonomous agent development
* Hands-on experience designing and implementing multi-agent orchestration systems and agent loop patterns (ReAct, Plan-and-Execute, or similar)
* Strong proficiency in Java (Spring Boot) and TypeScript/React for building full-stack agentic applications
* Solid understanding of LLM fundamentals: prompt engineering, context window management, function calling, structured outputs, and tool use
* Experience building RAG pipelines and working with vector databases .
* Demonstrated ability to implement agent safety guardrails including prompt-injection defences and output schema enforcement
* Experience with observability tooling (OpenTelemetry or equivalent) applied to distributed, AI-driven systems
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field .

  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications  
  
  

* Experience implementing or consuming MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and clients
* Familiarity with model routing and fallback strategies across multiple LLM providers
* Reactive programming in Java — Project Reactor, WebFlux — for streaming LLM responses
* Python proficiency for agent prototyping and evaluation pipeline scripting
* Hands-on experience with cloud AI platforms .
* Experience with agent sandboxing and safe code execution environments
* Awareness of fine-tuning, LoRA, and small-model distillation techniques for agent specialisation

Together, those functions deliver the technology behind every product story Apple tells and every purchase a customer makes.

The role calls for an engineer deeply committed to building high-performance, accessible, scalable, and innovative web experiences that continually delight and inspire customers around the world. With a strong eye for pixel-perfect detail and a passion for exceptional user experience, you will turn requirements, user journeys, and wireframes into intuitive, production-ready applications. You will work closely with UX designers, product managers, and backend engineers to transform ideas into elegant and reliable web experiences. The ideal candidate combines strong front-end engineering fundamentals with creative problem-solving, ownership, and a continuous desire to raise the bar on quality. You will also have opportunities to leverage Generative AI and AI-assisted development to accelerate engineering workflows, rapidly prototype ideas, improve productivity, and build innovative AI-powered user experiences.

* 4-8 years of professional front-end engineering experience building large-scale consumer- or enterprise-facing web applications.

* Practical experience using Generative AI tools such as ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, Claude, or equivalent to improve software development workflows

Job Description
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  

* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.

•
  

* Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the worlds greatest health threats.

Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our companys’ IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
  
  
A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking a Software Engineer with expertise in full-stack development, cloud technologies, and AI-driven engineering practices to build scalable enterprise solutions.
  
The role focuses on developing, deploying, and supporting AI products and platforms using modern technologies, DevSecOps, and automated delivery pipelines. The individual will collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive innovation, deliver high-quality software, and transition new concepts from pilot stages to production.

* We are looking for an innovative technologist passionate about cutting-edge tools and ready to accelerate delivery through AI code generation, pair programming assistants, and automated workflows
* Software development on backend (Python,TypeScript) and frontend (TypeScript/JavaScript - React framework).
* Write efficient and maintainable code following best practices in software engineering.
* Working with DevSecOps tools for deploying and versioning code.
* Deploy solutions on the cloud with CI/CD integration.
* Deliver enterprise AI projects, products, and platforms with a focus on scalability and reusability.
* Work on technical pilots and feasibility studies of new opportunities to create value and transitioning successful pilots to scalable production implementations.
* Develop integrations with other applications and services.
* Develop automated testing pipelines.
* Application release and second level support.
* Stay up to date with the latest advancements in software engineering technologies.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies with the team to execute on prioritized projects and features.
* Work closely with cross-functional teams, including product managers, data scientists, and software engineers, to understand requirements and deliver AI-driven solutions.

**What you should have :**

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description**

**About the Team**

The API Authentication team within Platform Security Engineering builds the security foundation that ensures every application, integration, mobile device, and AI agent connecting to ServiceNow can securely establish its identity. The team owns critical authentication capabilities including OAuth, OpenID Connect, API access policies, and mobile sign-in. As ServiceNow expands its AI capabilities, a key focus is enabling secure and trusted access for AI agents, making authentication seamless for users while keeping the platform protected.

**What you get to do in this role**:

* Design and develop scalable, maintainable, and reusable software components with a strong emphasis on performance and reliability.
* Collaborate with product managers to translate requirements into well-architected solutions, owning features from design through delivery
* Build intuitive and extensible user experiences using modern UI frameworks, ensuring flexibility for customer-specific needs.
* Contribute to the design and implementation of new products and features while enhancing existing product capabilities.
* Integrate automated testing into development workflows to ensure consistent quality across releases.
* Participate in design and code reviews ensuring best practices in performance, maintainability, and testability.
* Develop comprehensive test strategies covering functional, regression, integration and performance aspects
* Foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement by sharing best practices in engineering and quality.
* Promote a culture of engineering craftsmanship, knowledge-sharing, and thoughtful quality practices across the team.

  
**Qualifications**

**To be successful in this role you have****:**

* Experience in leveraging critical thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI’s potential impact on the function or industry.
* 5 to 8 years of experience in software engineering, with a track record of delivering high-quality products.
* Proficiency in Java, or similar object-oriented languages.
* Experience with modern front-end frameworks such as Angular, React, or Vue.
* Strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, design patterns, and performance optimization
* Familiarity with automated testing frameworks (e.g., JUnit, Selenium, TestNG) and integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines
* Understanding software quality principles including reliability, observability, and production readiness.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex systems and optimize performance across the stack.
* Experience with AI-powered tools or workflows, including validation of datasets, model predictions, and inference consistency.
* Comfort with development tools such as IDEs, debuggers, profilers, source control, and Unix-based systems

**Why Join Us**

* Build and deliver high-impact software that powers digital experiences for millions of users.
* Collaborate in a culture that values craftsmanship, quality, and innovation.
* Work symbiotically with AI and automation tools that enhance engineering excellence and drive product reliability.
* Be part of a culture that encourages innovation, continuous learning, and shared success.

  
**Additional Information**

**Work Personas**

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - APAC Onboarding & KYC
jobs.description:
**Company Description**
Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
  
  
**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**
Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
  
  
As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
  
  
**For everyone, everywhere.**
**Job Description**
More about
**our mission**
and
**what we offer**
.
  
  
Wise is building the best way to move and manage money across borders. To make that possible, customers need to be able to join Wise quickly, safely, and confidently.
  
  
We’re looking for a Principal Product Manager to join our Onboarding & KYC team in Hyderabad. You’ll own high-impact product work across APAC, helping Wise build onboarding and verification experiences that are low-friction for customers and prevent financial crime.
  
  
This is a senior role for someone who can operate in ambiguity, get deep into customer, regulatory, data, and technical details, and turn complex problems into shipped product outcomes.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Own product strategy and roadmap for APAC onboarding, KYC and financial crime mitigation initiatives, from discovery through delivery, launch, measurement, and iteration.
* Build and scale digital identity verification and eKYC experiences across markets such as Japan, Singapore, Australia, New Zealand, Thailand, Malaysia, Hong Kong, and the Philippines.
* Partner with Engineering, Design, Analytics, Operations, Risk & Compliance to balance conversion, customer experience, operational cost, regulatory requirements and financial crime risk.
* Lead complex localisation work, including integrating local identity providers, registry checks, and APAC-specific controls into Wise’s global platform.
* Improve customer onboarding outcomes such as first product adoption, verification completion, time-to-verify, manual review rates, cost-to-serve, and quality of fincrime decisions.
* Mitigating risk of financial crime by ensuring our in-product control environment accounts for country-specific financial crime risks.
* Use data, customer insight, operational feedback, and regulatory context to prioritise what matters most.
* Help generalise APAC’s strongest onboarding and KYC capabilities so they can be reused by other Wise product teams.
* Staying close to the details: customer journeys, dashboards, service architecture, regulatory interpretations, edge cases, incidents, and operational workflows.

**Qualifications**
**What we’re looking for**

* Significant product management experience, ideally in finance/fintech, identity, onboarding, KYC, risk, compliance, fraud, trust & safety, or another regulated domain.

+ 8+ years in the workforce with ideally 5+ years in product management or product-management adjacent roles.
+ For those with material experience outside of product management we still require a minimum of 3+ years in a senior product manager role

* A strong track record shipping customer-facing products end-to-end, not just writing strategy.
* Excellent structured problem solving: you can break down ambiguous, multi-stakeholder problems and create a practical path to impact.
* Strong analytical skills: you can define good metrics, interrogate data, work with SQL (or similar), and make trade-offs based on evidence.
* Enough technical depth to work with engineers on systems, integrations, reliability, observability, and platform design.
* Strong customer focus, including a habit of using customer research, support insights, funnel data, and operational feedback to shape product decisions.
* Clear, concise communication and the ability to influence senior stakeholders without relying on authority.
* High ownership, strong attention to detail, and willingness to roll up your sleeves,

**Nice to have**

* Experience with KYC/KYB: digital identity, national ID systems, government registry integrations, biometric or document verification, business onboarding,
* Experience in financial crime prevention: risk models (e.g. machine learning models), fraud/scam product prevention
* Experience launching products across multiple countries or adapting global platforms to local market requirements.
* Experience working with distributed teams across product, engineering, compliance, operations, and regional leadership.

**Location**
This role is based in Hyderabad, working closely with teams across Singapore, other APAC markets and Wise’s global product and engineering hubs.
  
  
Additional Information
  
  
For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
  
  
We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
  
  
Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.
  
  
If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.
  
  
Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Experience:**
Minimum 2 years of product management experience

**Number of openings:**
2

**About Delegenix**

Delegenix is an early-stage company building AI workers that help businesses get work done. By combining company knowledge, business rules, and integrations with existing applications, Delegenix enables AI workers to investigate requests, take approved actions, and deliver measurable business outcomes. Our focus is on practical automation across functions such as finance, sales, customer success, engineering, and operations.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a resourceful, hands-on Product Manager to establish our product management function and help shape what we build.

As Delegenix’s first and sole Product Manager, you will work directly with the founder and a small engineering team, taking ownership from customer discovery and prioritization through development, launch, and improvement. You will receive strategic direction and periodic guidance, while independently driving day-to-day product work.

This role suits someone who is intrinsically motivated, comfortable with ambiguity, and able to turn an initial idea or loosely defined business problem into a clear, practical solution.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Understand customers and their workflows:**
  Speak directly with prospective customers and users to identify recurring problems, understand existing processes, and validate where AI and automation can provide meaningful value.
* **Shape product priorities:**
  Translate the company’s direction and customer insights into a focused roadmap and actionable backlog. Make clear recommendations about what to build, defer, or simplify based on customer value, technical feasibility, and available capacity.
* **Define requirements and experiences:**
  Create concise product requirement documents, user stories, workflow maps, wireframes, and acceptance criteria. Specify business rules, exceptions, approval steps, and expected outcomes.
* **Drive execution with engineering:**
  Work closely with engineers to discuss feasibility, clarify requirements, manage scope, resolve open questions, and keep delivery moving.
* **Validate functionality and AI outputs:**
  Own product acceptance testing, document issues, and verify fixes. Define how AI workers should behave, when human approval is needed, and how successful task completion should be assessed.
* **Support launches and adoption:**
  Prepare product demonstrations, onboarding materials, release notes, and user documentation. Work with the founder on positioning and communication for early customers.
* **Measure and improve:**
  Establish practical measures of adoption, task completion, output quality, time saved, and customer satisfaction. Use findings to improve the product.
* **Build the product function:**
  Introduce lightweight practices for discovery, prioritization, documentation, feedback collection, and release planning that suit a small team.

**Required Experience and Skills**

* At least 2 years of hands-on product management experience in software products, with examples of features or products taken from problem definition to release.
* Demonstrated ability to own work independently, make reasoned decisions, and follow through without frequent supervision.
* Strong product judgment: able to distinguish a genuine customer problem from a feature request and define a manageable first version of a solution.
* Ability to conduct customer conversations, map workflows, and translate findings into clear requirements.
* Strong written and verbal communication, including clear product documentation and effective discussions with technical and business audiences.
* Working understanding of APIs, integrations, data flows, and cloud applications sufficient to discuss requirements and trade-offs with engineers.
* Practical understanding of AI tools and their limitations, including the need to validate outputs and define appropriate human oversight.
* Analytical thinking, attention to detail, and comfort using product data and customer feedback to make decisions.
* A self-directed working style, curiosity, and willingness to learn unfamiliar business domains.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in an early-stage startup or helping build a product from an initial concept.
* Exposure to B2B software, workflow automation, AI products, or products involving third-party integrations.
* Familiarity with prototyping tools, product analytics, SQL, or low-code tools.
* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline or equivalent practical experience. An MBA is not required.

**What Success Looks Like**

You establish a clear understanding of priority customer problems, maintain a focused roadmap, and help the engineering team deliver useful, well-defined solutions. Early customer feedback translates into visible improvements, and the product function operates reliably without requiring the founder to coordinate every detail.

**Why Join Delegenix?**

* Help shape a new company’s product and customer experience from the beginning.
* Work directly with the founder and engineers, with meaningful ownership of decisions and outcomes.
* Build practical AI solutions and see their impact on real business workflows.
* Establish the foundations of a product function that can grow with the company.

of relevant product management experience, with hands-on experience in

Based on experience and role fit

**Working Hours:**
1:00 PM–11:00 PM IST, including allocated breaks

**Joining:**
Immediate joiners or candidates available within one week preferred

**About Zexovo and EduNage**

**Zexovo**
builds AI-powered software that simplifies business operations. EduNage is our school management platform, designed to help institutions streamline administration and support educators, students, and families.

**EduNage’s**
AI capabilities include conflict-free timetable generation, analysis of attendance, homework and academic performance, and priority alerts that help educators identify students needing additional support.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a full-time Product Manager with practical experience in school ERP or school management software to help shape and improve EduNage.

You should understand how schools operate, how different departments use an ERP, and how information flows between administrators, teachers, students, and parents. You will translate those needs into clear product requirements and work closely with our product lead, designers, engineers, and QA team to deliver usable, reliable features.

This role combines product ownership, domain research, workflow design, documentation, and release validation. You should be comfortable taking a feature from identifying the problem through development, testing, launch, and improvement.

**What You Will Do**

* Speak with school administrators, principals, teachers, and other stakeholders to understand their workflows, challenges, and priorities.
* Translate school requirements into product requirement documents, functional specifications, user stories, and measurable acceptance criteria.
* Map workflows across admissions, student records, attendance, fees, examinations, report cards, timetables, communication, and parent and student portals.
* Define how modules connect, including dependencies, permissions, approval processes, notifications, and reporting requirements.
* Work with the product lead to prioritize the backlog and plan releases based on user needs, business value, and engineering effort.
* Collaborate with designers and engineers to make complex school processes simple and intuitive across web and mobile experiences.
* Define requirements for AI features, including timetable generation, student performance reviews, attendance insights, and priority alerts.
* Specify when AI-generated recommendations require educator review, how users can correct results, and how exceptions should be handled.
* Document standard workflows and edge cases such as timetable conflicts, student transfers, academic-year transitions, fee adjustments, and corrections to attendance or marks.
* Research competing school ERP platforms and identify meaningful opportunities for improvement.
* Work with QA to create test scenarios, conduct user acceptance testing, and verify that delivered features meet requirements.
* Support school onboarding, product demonstrations, feedback collection, and issue prioritization.
* Track feature adoption, workflow completion, user feedback, and recurring support issues to guide improvements.

**Minimum Requirements**

* At least 1 year of relevant experience in product management, with direct involvement in a school ERP, school management system, or education administration platform.
* Practical understanding of school operations and the workflows used by administrators, academic coordinators, teachers, parents, and students.
* Experience working on multiple school ERP modules and understanding how they interact.
* Ability to independently create clear requirements, workflow diagrams, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Experience collaborating with engineering, design, and QA teams throughout feature delivery.
* Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and the ability to identify workflow gaps and edge cases.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain requirements to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Familiarity with documentation and product tracking tools such as Notion, Google Docs, Jira, ClickUp, or similar platforms.
* Availability for a full-time role during the stated working hours.

**Direct school ERP or school management software experience is required. Experience limited to online learning or course-content platforms does not, by itself, meet this requirement.**

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with school ERP implementation, onboarding, configuration, or data migration.
* Familiarity with transport, library, hostel, inventory, staff management, or multi-campus workflows.
* Experience with AI-powered features, workflow automation, or education analytics.
* Understanding of role-based access, student data privacy, audit trails, and approval controls.
* Familiarity with payment gateway integrations, messaging services, or attendance devices.
* Experience using Figma, Miro, Lucidchart, or draw.io.
* A portfolio demonstrating product documentation, workflow analysis, or features you helped deliver.

**What You Will Gain**

* Ownership of meaningful features in an AI-powered school management platform.
* Direct collaboration with the founding team and product lead.
* The opportunity to influence product priorities and improve real school workflows.
* Experience building AI-assisted tools that reduce administrative effort and help educators make informed decisions.
* Opportunities to grow your responsibilities as the product and team expand.
* **Explore EduNage:**
  https://zexovo.com/edunage

jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager
jobs.description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start
**Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**
As a Senior Technical Product Manager for AI Products & Solutions, you'll set the vision and roadmap for AI-powered products and run delivery for them. These include generative AI copilots, agentic digital workers and intelligent automation used across healthcare operations such as claims, prior authorization, member, provider operations and care administration. You'll work with engineering, data science, architecture and business leaders to turn complex problems into AI solutions that are safe, scalable and measurable.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Product vision and strategy: Set and own the vision, strategy and multi-quarter roadmap for AI/GenAI products, tied to business goals and enterprise AI priorities
* Problem discovery: Work with business stakeholders to find high-value AI use cases, assess whether they're feasible, and build business cases with clear ROI, savings and capacity metrics
* Backlog ownership: Turn strategy into epics, features and user stories with clear acceptance criteria. Prioritize the backlog by value, risk and dependencies
* AI solution design: Work with data scientists, ML/LLM engineers and architects on model selection, prompt and agent design, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), evaluation frameworks and human-in-the-loop workflows
* Delivery leadership: Lead agile delivery across scrum teams from idea through POC, pilot, UAT and production, including release planning and go-live readiness
* AI and compliance: Make sure solutions meet
* AI principles, privacy rules (HIPAA, PHI/PII), security and model governance, including bias, explainability and auditability
* Measurement: Define and track product KPIs such as adoption, accuracy, automation rate, cycle-time reduction, cost savings and FTE capacity. Use the data to improve the product
* Stakeholder management: Present status, risks and outcomes to executive leadership. Build alignment across technology, operations and business teams
* Adoption and change management: Drive enablement through demos, office hours, documentation, FAQs and feedback loops
* Market awareness: Keep up with trends in GenAI, agentic AI, LLMOps and AI platforms, and bring in new ideas and reusable patterns
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a related field (or equivalent experience)
* 10+ years in technology, including 5+ years in product management or technical product ownership
* Experience managing AI/ML, GenAI or intelligent automation products from concept to production
* Hands-on experience with Agile/Scrum/SAFe and tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Rally or Aha!
* Proven experience building business cases and reporting outcomes to senior leadership
* Solid understanding of LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, AI agents, model evaluation and MLOps/LLMOps concepts
* Proven ability to translate business needs into technical requirements and to work credibly with engineers and data scientists
* Proven excellent written and verbal communication, storytelling and stakeholder management skills
* Preferred Qualifications:
* Master's degree or MBA
* Certifications such as CSPO, SAFe POPM, PMP or AI/ML certifications
* Experience in US healthcare (payer, provider or PBM), such as claims, utilization management, prior authorization or provider data
* Experience leading distributed, global teams

**Key Competencies**

* Strategic thinking
* Customer focus
* Data-driven decisions
* Technical depth in AI
* Executive communication
* Collaboration
* Comfort with ambiguity
* Responsible innovation

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

jobs.title: (Agentic) Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About This Role**
We are building a durable execution process engine – a platform that bridges enterprise workflow automation and intelligent agent orchestration. This is a zero-to-one product launch from concept to market.
  
  
You will lead the product strategy and execution for one of three interconnected pillars in the platform (Durable Processes, Data Connectors, AI Agents). Working alongside peer PMs and reporting to the Group PM, you'll own the complete customer journey: from defining what we build, to shipping it, to ensuring it lands with users.
  
  
This role is for a PM who has shipped complex, multi-layer platform products before and who thrives in the tension between technical ambition and customer reality.
  
  
**The Product Vision**
A durable execution engine that scales from developer laptops to enterprise clouds, bringing workflow automation, intelligent agents, and real-time data integration into one coherent platform.
  
  
Modern enterprises are stuck. Legacy workflow systems are rigid and don't integrate with AI. Code-first pipelines (Airflow, Temporal) give developers freedom but leave business analysts behind. We're building the bridge.
  
  
**Our Platform Will**

* Work for multiple personas – Business analysts author visually, engineers deploy as code, operators observe in real time. No translation layer needed.
* Treat AI as native – Intelligent agents aren't bolted on; they're first-class actors in the process execution model with full auditability and compliance guardrails.
* Connect everything – Data from any source (APIs, databases, message queues, cloud services) flows naturally through your processes without custom plumbing.
* Build toward Horizon's sophistication – Our long-term ambition is to deliver agentic orchestration depth comparable to the best-in-class products in the market.

The result: enterprises can automate complex work faster, with more control, and with confidence that their processes will execute reliably at scale.
  
  
**What You'll Own**
Strategic ownership
  
  

* Define the product roadmap for Workflows & Orchestration – what customers need, what moves the needle, what builds defensible value
* Make the hard calls: what ships in MVP, what is post-launch, what never ships
* Own the competitive positioning – position durable processes as a first-class pillar of an integrated platform, not a standalone point solution
* Shape both pro-code and no-code experiences – own SDKs, CLI, and visual editor consistency; documentation and learning paths across both personas

Execution leadership
  
  

* Lead cross-functional alignment (eng, design, marketing, sales) on priorities and milestones
* Conduct customer discovery: who are we building for, what problems do they have, what's blocking adoption
* Make data-driven decisions: usage patterns, customer feedback, performance metrics all inform direction
* Unblock ambiguity: when technical direction isn't clear, you synthesize information and move forward decisively

Partnership with peer PMs
  
  

* You're not alone – work collaboratively with two peer IC PMs who own the Data Connectors and AI Agents pillars
* Establish clear integration points and contract boundaries so all three pillars (Durable Processes, Data Connectors, AI Agents) work together seamlessly
* Escalate only real conflicts up to the Group PM; resolve most decisions at your level

**We're Looking For**
**Experience Shipping One Or More Of The Following**
Complex infrastructure or platform products
  
  

* Enterprise workflow or automation systems
* Products that span multiple user personas (business analysts, developers, operators)
* Products that required deep technical integration
* Zero-to-one launches where you shaped initial product-market fit.

Core capabilities
  
  

* Technical fluency – You read code, understand architecture constraints, and can have a real conversation with engineers about feasibility and tradeoffs. You don't need to be an engineer, but you think like one.
* Customer obsession with realism – You spend time with users, but you're not a feature-request transcriber. You synthesize what they need from what they say.
* Decisiveness under ambiguity – You make calls with incomplete information. You're comfortable killing ideas you love if data suggests they won't work.
* Communication across layers – You talk to engineers about latency budgets, to customers about compliance, to executives about roadmap priorities. Different audiences, same honesty.
* Systems thinking – You see how pieces connect. Developer SDKs influence adoption patterns. Pricing models influence feature prioritization. You optimize for the system, not the local maximum.
* AI native – You’re using LLMs as part of your product workflow and can adapt to any tool easily. We currently use Claude Code and Cursor.

Nice to have
  
  

* 5+ years of relevant experience as a Product Manager, with a strong focus on platform products.
* Exposure to workflow engines, BPM systems, or process orchestration platforms (Camunda, Zeebe, Airflow, Temporal).
* Experience with enterprise compliance requirements (SOC 2, PCI-DSS, HIPAA) and how they shape product architecture.
* Understanding of multi-tenant SaaS scaling challenges and tradeoffs
* Previous zero-to-one product launch where you defined the initial MVP and shaped early-stage product-market fit.
* Experience building features using LLMs (it can be a hobby project).

**Job Description:**  
The Digital Technologies Product Owner (Architect) - Plan Deliver is the senior end-to-end technology product owner for supply chain planning and delivery capabilities across Mars Snacking AMEA, responsible for product strategy, architecture direction, roadmap, portfolio priorities, delivery and value realization.

**Job Summary**

This hybrid role for a Functional Architect focuses on designing and optimizing accessible digital solutions that comply with accessibility standards and support inclusive user experiences for diverse communities. The architect will partner with cross functional teams to embed accessibility consulting practices into product design and testing using tools such as NVDA screen reader and Jmeter for performance and usability validation across assessment solutions and enterprise platforms.

**Responsibilities**

* Design accessible functional architectures for complex digital products to ensure inclusive user experiences that align with organizational accessibility goals and industry standards
* Oversee end to end accessibility assessments across applications by applying structured consulting methodologies that highlight usability barriers for diverse user groups
* Collaborate closely with product owners and business analysts to translate requirements into accessible workflows that reduce friction for users who rely on assistive technologies
* Coordinate hybrid working routines with technical and business stakeholders to ensure continuity of solution design reviews and accessibility validation activities during day shifts
* Guide testers on using NVDA screen reader to verify that user interface components are perceivable operable and understandable for individuals with varying abilities
* Apply Jmeter and Apache Jmeter for performance and load testing to confirm that accessibility features remain reliable and responsive under high traffic and complex interaction scenarios
* Develop clear functional specifications and accessibility acceptance criteria that enable development teams to implement predictable and consistent behavior for all users
* Conduct structured accessibility consulting sessions with cross functional teams to promote awareness of inclusive design practices and to support ongoing process improvement initiatives
* Review existing enterprise solutions and assessment platforms to identify accessibility gaps and recommend pragmatic remediation strategies that enhance societal impact through improved access
* Document functional flows and test scenarios that integrate accessibility requirements so that quality assurance teams can reliably validate compliance and user experience outcomes
* Engage with stakeholders from assessment bodies or similar domains to align solution capabilities with formal evaluation practices and to support transparent and fair digital assessments
* Mentor peers on accessibility concepts and tooling usage by sharing practical examples of successful implementations that demonstrate measurable improvements in user satisfaction
* Track accessibility and performance metrics to provide insights on how implemented solutions advance company purpose by reducing barriers and expanding participation from underrepresented communities

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrate strong experience in accessibility consulting by applying recognized guidelines and frameworks to digital products across multiple platforms and business contexts
* Exhibit advanced proficiency with NVDA screen reader to assess navigation structure form behavior and content presentation and to communicate clear findings to technical teams
* Utilize Jmeter and Apache Jmeter effectively to script performance tests that validate stability of accessible features and ensure reliable operation under expected usage patterns
* Bring practical exposure to accessibility practices in enterprise or public sector environments and show the ability to embed those practices into repeatable solution design processes
* Offer domain familiarity with assessment bodies or certification organizations and use that knowledge to shape functional architectures that support equitable evaluation experiences
* Communicate in native level English across spoken and written channels to articulate complex accessibility concepts and testing outcomes to both technical and nontechnical audiences
* Apply structured analytical thinking gained from seven to ten years of professional experience to balance accessibility performance and functional requirements within hybrid work settings

**Certifications Required**

Certified Professional in Accessibility Core Competencies CPACC or comparable accessibility certification

jobs.title: Servicenow Architect
jobs.description:
**Role & responsibilities**

We are hiring a Senior ServiceNow Architect in Pune to own the technical vision, design, and governance of the ServiceNow platform. This is a hands-on leadership role and the organization's top technical authority on ServiceNow.

* Own end-to-end solution architecture across ServiceNow product lines, including ITSM, ITOM, ITBM/SPM, HRSD, CSM, and SecOps, as applicable.
* Define platform standards, design patterns, data models, and governance for scalability, performance, security, and maintainability.
* Translate business requirements into technical designs and make build-vs-configure decisions.
* Architect integrations with ERP, HRIS, CMDB sources, identity/SSO, monitoring tools, and third-party APIs.
* Design integrations using IntegrationHub, REST/SOAP web services, MID Servers, event-driven patterns, and data-import strategies.
* Set standards for integration governance, error handling, reconciliation, and security.
* Lead CMDB/CSDM design and data integrity strategy.
* Lead and mentor ServiceNow developers, admins, and consultants through design and code reviews.
* Own delivery quality across the SDLC, including estimation, sprint planning, technical standards, and release management.
* Align the platform roadmap with business priorities alongside product owners, business leaders, and vendors.
* Chair the technical governance/CAB function and manage upgrades, technical debt, and instance strategy.
* Advise leadership on platform strategy, licensing, and emerging capabilities, including AI/Now Assist.

**Preferred candidate profile**

**Must have:**

* 10+ years of enterprise IT experience, including 5+ years architecting and delivering ServiceNow solutions at scale.
* Experience delivering complex enterprise integrations using IntegrationHub, REST/SOAP, MID Server, web services, and event/messaging patterns.
* Experience leading technical teams and owning delivery quality across multiple concurrent workstreams.
* Deep platform expertise in JavaScript, Glide, Flow Designer, Service Portal, ACLs/security, CMDB/CSDM, and performance optimization.
* Strong understanding of ITSM/ITIL processes and enterprise architecture principles.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence both engineers and executives.
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA).
* One or more Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) credentials, such as ITSM, ITOM, HRSD, or CSM.

**Good to have:**

* ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect (CTA) or Certified Master Architect (strongly preferred).
* IntegrationHub or other relevant micro-certifications.
* Exposure to Agile delivery, CI/CD, automated testing (ATF), and multi-instance/global deployments.
* Familiarity with AWS, Azure, or GCP, and with SSO, SAML, and OAuth.

**Perks and benefits**

* Competitive compensation, based on experience
* Senior leadership role with ownership of the platform's technical direction
* Opportunity to shape the enterprise ServiceNow roadmap and governance
* Exposure to complex, enterprise-scale integrations
* Opportunity to mentor and grow a ServiceNow team.

* **Opportunity to be one of our first team members in Woolworths Group India in Bangalore.**

  

***Woolworths Group India is partnering exclusively with Zinnov Group to recruit for this position.***

  

**About this role**

As an established member of a Hosting team, the **Principle** **Engineer** independently delivers, operates, and improves the team's services, with a focused emphasis on designing, building, managing, delivering and influencing those services through code and automation. The role takes ownership of well-defined pieces of work end-to-end and contributes to the reliability, security, and continuous improvement of the team's service domain.

  

**What youll do**

* **Software Engineering Leadership:** Extensive proficiency in software engineering, including high-level architecture patterns and the creation of scalable systems in intricate landscapes.
* **Strategic Technical Influence:** Demonstrated capacity to modernise vital platforms, sway technical roadmaps, and align senior technical leaders.
* **Modern Engineering Practices:** Substantial background in AI-powered development, process automation, and cloud ecosystems like Azure or GCP.
* **DevOps & Infrastructure Mastery:** Deep expertise in managing CI/CD lifecycles and utilising infrastructure as code within distributed, API-driven environments.
* **Architectural Patterns & Mentorship:** Advocate of scalable architectural standards who empowers teams through mentorship and ensures robust security and stability guardrails.
* **Communication & Impact:** Exceptional leadership skills capable of bridging engineering and business objectives to deliver significant outcomes across various domains.
* **Quality & Delivery:** Committed to advancing engineering quality

  

**What youll bring**

* Approximately 15+ years of commercial experience in a dedicated engineering role within complex, enterprise-scale environments.
* **Code-Driven Practices:** Minimum 10+ years of hands-on experience utilising code-driven methodologies (such as Infrastructure as Code, Configuration as Code, or automated scripting languages) to manage and scale platforms.
* **Legacy to Modern Transitions:** Direct experience migrating legacy systems or manual operational workflows over to modern, highly automated, and resilient target-state architectures.
* **Incident Ownership & SRE Practice:** Demonstrated experience leading root-cause analysis (RCA) investigations and implementing permanent engineering fixes to eliminate systemic operational toil.
* **Secure Engineering Practice:** Proven experience hardening enterprise environments against cyber threats and a track record of successfully driving rapid patch management or vulnerability remediation campaigns in production environments.
* **Squad-Based Delivery:** Proven experience working within an Agile framework, Product-operating model, or DevOps squad environment, collaborating daily with Product Owners and Scrum Masters to deliver platform features.
* **Purpose-Driven Innovation:** Above all, we are seeking collaborative innovators and progressive technical thinkers who don't just maintain the status quo, but actively help us engineer better ways to bring a little good to everyone, every day.

  

**What you’ll experience**

* Be a part of Australia’s largest retailer
* Constant mentoring and training provided
* Generous performance based bonus
* 20 days annual leave
* A flexible approach to work
* Premium insurance coverage for you and your dependants

We recognise the value our team’s diversity brings to our business, customers, and communities and that teams with diverse experiences and backgrounds enrich our group and are better able to innovate and solve problems. **Job Description**
Position Summary
  
  
The Business Transformation Analyst, Supply Chain will be based in Hyderabad, India and will support Project Phoenix across the Source to Pay (S2P), Make to Deliver (M2D), and Forecast to Plan (F2P) workstreams. This role will work closely with business stakeholders, track leads, IT, and implementation partners to improve process clarity, maintain requirements traceability, support testing readiness, and help drive cutover preparation for Oracle transformation activities. The role emphasize is on data accuracy, cross-functional coordination, reporting, process discipline, and strong execution in a fast-paced environment.
  
  
**About The Role**
This position plays a key role in helping NextPower translate business process requirements into structured, testable, and executable project outputs. The analyst will partner with global and Hyderabad-based teams to support business process design, scenario preparation, issue tracking, reporting, and readiness activities across CRP, SIT, UAT, and cutover. The role requires a detail-oriented, analytical, and collaborative professional who can connect business needs with disciplined project execution.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Support Project Phoenix execution across S2P, M2D, and F2P by coordinating requirements, action items, dependencies, and follow-ups across business, IT, and implementation teams.
* Prepare and organize CRP1 and CRP2 scope, business scenarios, test data inputs, and session materials to support structured walkthroughs and design validation.
* Coordinate with Hyderabad-based and global stakeholders to ensure timely completion of workstream deliverables, issue resolution, and decision closure across time zones.
* Maintain Jira traceability across tracks and phases by linking stories, tasks, RAID items, and test-related activities to the correct workstream and milestone.
* Support SIT preparation and execution by helping define test scenarios, coordinating defect logging, tracking issue remediation, and confirming test coverage across business processes and requirements.
* Support UAT readiness and execution by preparing scripts, coordinating end-to-end business testing, tracking issues, and helping assemble business sign-off evidence.
* Assist with data conversion and validation activities, including field mapping support, test load coordination, reconciliation follow-up, and pre-cutover readiness checks.
* Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, status summaries, KPI tracking, and executive-ready updates to support business and program decisions.
* Identify process gaps, execution risks, and improvement opportunities, and contribute to practical solutions that improve standardization, quality, and delivery discipline.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Engineering, Operations, Information Systems, or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience in business analysis, transformation, supply chain operations, ERP-enabled process improvement, or program support roles.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to collect, organize, analyze, and communicate information with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
* Experience working cross-functionally with procurement, planning, manufacturing, operations, engineering, finance, and other business stakeholders.
* Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and enterprise systems used for planning, reporting, and execution tracking.
* Experience with project management and collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, or similar workflow and documentation platforms.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across global teams and functions.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and drive follow-through in a dynamic transformation environment.
* Familiarity with dashboards, KPI reporting, and data-driven decision support.

* Experience in ERP transformation and/or supporting Oracle, Anaplan, or related ERP / planning platforms.
* Experience in supply chain, manufacturing, procurement, planning, or renewable energy environments.

jobs.title: AS400 Architect
jobs.description:
We are looking for a seasoned **AS/400 Architect** to define the technical vision and architectural direction for the AI Tools team, shaping EPAM's in-house solution for IBM iSeries (AS/400) application reverse engineering, analysis, and modernization at an enterprise scale.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Define the architectural vision, standards, and technical roadmap for the IBM iSeries (AS/400) reverse-engineering and modernization solution
* Conduct application portfolio analysis to identify redundant, unreachable, duplicated, obsolete, tightly coupled, and highly complex code, and assess application quality, maintainability, performance, technical debt, modernization readiness, and potential risks
* Analyze legacy IBM AS/400 applications, identify dependencies and business rules, trace data flows, document application behavior, and assess undocumented or complex codebases
* Drive IBM AS/400 modernization approaches, including code refactoring, format conversion, database modernization, API and web-service enablement, UI modernization, application decomposition, cloud integration, re-platforming, and application retirement
* Collaborate with the AI Tools team to define requirements, validate analysis logic, improve prompts and rules, and enhance the accuracy of AI-generated application documentation and code insights
* Architect AI capabilities for program understanding, dependency discovery, business-rule extraction, data-flow analysis, impact analysis, code summarization, test-case generation, and modernization recommendations
* Contribute to technical assessments, proofs of concept, solution demonstrations, effort estimation, project planning, risk identification, progress reporting, and executive-level presentations
* Partner with customer IBM i SMEs, application owners, business analysts, modernization specialists, AI Tools team members, testing teams, cloud architects, and Technical Leadership across the client and EPAM organizations
* Ensure that the reverse-engineering and modernization solution complies with enterprise architecture standards, customer security policies, source-code handling requirements, data-protection controls, audit requirements, and applicable regulatory obligations

**Requirements**

* 13+ years of experience in enterprise midrange (iSeries or AS/400) technologies, with 5+ years focused on application analysis, reverse engineering, and modernization solutions
* Expertise in RPG III, RPG IV, and RPGLE, including hands-on development, maintenance, and refactoring of large-scale legacy applications
* Proficiency in free-format RPG, CL/CLLE, and COBOL, with the ability to analyze and convert fixed-format code to modern equivalents
* Skills in DDS, DSPFs, and SQL, including designing, interpreting, and optimizing display files, physical/logical files, and complex queries
* Background in Db2 for i, covering database design, performance tuning, journaling, stored procedures, triggers, and DDS-to-DDL conversion
* Understanding of IBM i architecture, including libraries, objects, service programs, printer files, commitment control, and integrated file systems
* Knowledge of reverse engineering techniques for legacy AS/400 applications, including dependency mapping, business-rule extraction, and data-flow tracing
* Familiarity with modernization strategies such as API enablement, web-service integration, UI modernization, application decomposition, cloud migration, and re-platforming
* Competency in application portfolio assessment, technical debt evaluation, code quality analysis, and modernization readiness reviews
* Capability to collaborate with AI Tools teams by defining requirements, validating analysis logic, refining prompts, and improving AI-generated documentation and code insights
* Flexibility to support delivery activities, including proofs of concept, effort estimation, project planning, risk identification, and executive-level presentations
* Showcase of strong stakeholder management skills to engage IBM i SMEs, application owners, business analysts, cloud architects, and technical leadership across client and internal organizations
* Qualifications in governance and compliance, ensuring adherence to enterprise architecture standards, security policies, data-protection controls, and regulatory obligations
* Proficiency in English at an Upper-Intermediate level (B2) or higher

jobs.title: Product Manager - Water Enhancement
jobs.description:
Global Water Solutions (GWS), one of the world’s leading manufacturers of pressure vessels, water enhancement and smart tap products, is looking for a commercially minded and technically capable **Product Manager – Water Enhancement** to drive the development and growth of our filtration, UF, RO, RO.M and Quatreau/Q product ranges.

Working closely with management, sales, engineering and production teams, you will own the product journey from market research and concept development through to certification, production readiness, launch and ongoing improvement. The role will support our domestic Indian business and international markets, including the Middle East, Southeast Asia and Oceania.

**Key responsibilities**

* Develop the Water Enhancement product roadmap, supported by market research, business cases and product briefs.
* Define product specifications, target costs, pricing inputs and launch priorities in collaboration with sales.
* Coordinate engineering, suppliers, assembly readiness, testing and product validation.
* Identify and manage certification and compliance requirements, including DWD, WRAS, WQA/NSF and other regional standards.
* Lead product launches, including positioning, marketing materials, sales tools and regional training.
* Visit factories, customers and trade shows, monitoring market feedback and product performance.

  

**Requirements**

**Essential experience and capabilities**

* At least 5 years' experience in technical product management or product development.
* Proven ownership of technical products from opportunity assessment through to successful market launch.
* Ability to translate customer and market needs into clear, actionable engineering requirements.
* Strong commercial judgement, including product costing, value, pricing and market positioning.
* Proven ability to coordinate cross-functional teams across engineering, production, marketing and sales.
* Excellent English communication skills and willingness to travel internationally.

  

**Desirable experience**

* Background in water treatment, filtration, UF/RO systems, water dispensers or connected appliances.
* Experience coordinating product certification and compliance projects.
* Exposure to international export markets and regional regulatory requirements.

  

**Why join GWS?**

At GWS, you will have the opportunity to shape the future of our Water Enhancement portfolio within a growing international business. You will work with global teams, influence product strategy and bring innovative water technologies to markets around the world.

We offer a dynamic and friendly working environment, where initiative, collaboration and achievement are valued, and individuals are encouraged to develop their skills and career potential.

Your first 90 days

Your initial priorities will include reviewing the existing product portfolio, developing a prioritised product roadmap, establishing a certification matrix and preparing a clear launch action plan with agreed responsibilities, milestones and commercial objectives.

Last, but not least, if you’re curious to learn more about Global Water Solutions, feel free to visit our company website and LinkedIn page linked below.

jobs.title: Sr Developer (.NET)
jobs.description:
Posting Description:

**Job Title- Sr Developer**

**Position type-** Full Time

**Work Location- Bangalore, Noida, Gurgaon**

**Working style-** Hybrid

**Cab Facility-** Yes

**Shift Time –** 12:30 PM to 9:30 PM

**People Manager role: No**

**Required education and certifications are critical for the role:** Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

**Required years of experience: 10-14 years**

**AON IS IN THE BUSINESS OF BETTER DECISIONS**

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are committed as one firm to our purpose, united through trust as one inclusive, diverse team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

**Job Description Summary**

The Senior Developer will build and support Aon's implementation of Eagle PACE, part of BNY's Data & Analytics platform (formerly Eagle Investment Systems), within Aon's Investment Consulting technology portfolio. This is hands-on development inside Eagle: customizing the latest version of Eagle PACE (now marketed by BNY as Eagle Data Management) so that it works for Aon, processes Aon's investment data, and exchanges data with the systems around it. Eagle PACE experience is good to have but not mandatory. Strong senior .NET developers without Eagle experience are encouraged to apply and will be trained on Eagle PACE once they join. The role shares a common C#, .NET, SQL Server, and REST API foundation with the wider development team.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build, test, and support Eagle PACE customizations that meets Aon's business and data requirements.
* Develop and maintain Eagle data processing, to load, validate, transform, and enrich Aon's investment data using Eagle PACE tools like IWS, EDS, and panels.
* Build and support interfaces that move data into and out of Eagle PACE, including inbound feeds, outbound extracts, and connections to other Aon systems.
* Develop and maintain supporting applications, services, and tools using C# and .NET.
* Write and tune SQL for data processing, validation, and troubleshooting.
* Troubleshoot production issues in Eagle processing and interfaces, and drive defects to resolution.
* Provide application support and assist with incidents for the Investment applications you support.
* Work with business stakeholders and product owners to analyze requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
* Take part in Eagle Pace upgrades so that Aon's customizations keep working on the latest version.
* Participate in code reviews and follow team development standards.
* Contribute to technical documentation and knowledge transfer.

When you're part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, you'll do meaningful work that enables our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. As the world leader in serving science, our digital ecosystem powers billions of dollars in customer interactions and supports scientists, researchers, healthcare professionals and industrial customers around the globe. Our Digital Customer Experience organization is responsible for defining and delivering the future of digital commerce across our digital experiences.

As a Senior Digital Product Manager, APAC, you will serve as the regional product leader connecting Asia Pacific market performance, customer needs and commercial priorities to Thermo Fisher Scientific's global digital product strategy. You will develop a fact-based point of view on where Digital can improve customer outcomes and commercial performance across the region, with particular attention to the different market structures, customer behaviors, dealer models and platform maturity that shape digital adoption in APAC.
