jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About Bolna**
===============

Bolna is Voice AI infrastructure built for India, and now for the world. We help businesses deploy intelligent voice agents that can call, converse, and convert in any language, at scale. From collections to customer support to sales, our agents handle millions of conversations so humans don't have to.

We're a YC F25 company, backed by General Catalyst, with 1,050+ paying customers and growing fast. Our team of 70+ is based in Bengaluru.

**The Role**
============

Bolna's voice agents handle millions of real conversations for some of India's largest enterprises. Every one of those calls has to sound natural, and when one goes wrong, we need to know why, fast.

As a Product Manager, you'll own two areas: how the call sounds and feels to the person on the other end, and how we, our FDEs and our customers know whether an agent is working and why it isn't. You'll decide which problems matter most, define what "better" means, and ship improvements that work for every customer, not just one. This role is for someone who has done this before: you'll set the direction for both areas, not execute a roadmap someone else wrote.

You'll work with the founders and the engineering, ML and FDE teams, sometimes on your own and sometimes alongside another PM or an engineering lead. It's a hands-on role: you'll write the spec, and often the first SQL query, prompt or prototype too.

**What You'll Do**
==================

**In-call experience**
----------------------

* Own the quality of the live conversation: background noise and noise cancellation, turn-taking and interruptions, latency, and language switching.
* Drive agent memory: context that carries across calls, between steps of a multi-step agent, and through agent-to-agent transfers.
* Work with ML engineers on model choices and the models we build. Define what "better" means, build the eval set, and decide when an in-house model is ready to replace a vendor.
* Turn fuzzy complaints from FDEs and customers ("the agent sounds off", "it keeps cutting people off") into metrics with clear thresholds.

**Observability**
-----------------

* Make it fast to find out why a call went wrong: which turn, which component (telephony, speech recognition, LLM, voice, tools), and what to change.
* Shape the dashboards, call-level debugging views and automated evals, including LLM-as-judge, that FDEs and customers use every day.
* Define the handful of quality and reliability metrics the company watches, and own their accuracy.
* Spot recurring failure patterns across thousands of calls before customers report them.

**What We're Looking For**
==========================

**Must-have**
-------------

* 4+ years in product management, or in an engineering, consulting, analytics or founding role where you owned what got built and why. You've shipped products that moved a metric you can name.
* You communicate clearly in writing and in person. A one-page problem statement from you gets engineers, FDEs and customers on the same page.
* You're a driver with high ownership. You take responsibility for outcomes, not tickets, and follow up until the fix works in production.
* You're comfortable handling many small problems in a week and one hard problem over a quarter.
* You can work independently, and you also work well alongside other PMs and engineering leads.

**Preferred**
-------------

* **Problem solving.** You break messy, ambiguous problems into clear parts, find the root cause, and pick the simplest fix that works.
* **Data sense.** You go to the data before forming a view. You write your own SQL, can tell a real pattern from noise, and notice when a number looks wrong and work out why.
* **Technical understanding.** You know how systems fit together and can reason about LLMs, APIs, latency and trade-offs. You read logs and API docs and hold your own in design discussions with engineers. You don't need to write production code.

**Good-to-have**
----------------

* Experience with voice AI, conversational AI, LLM products, or developer and infrastructure platforms.
* Hands-on with LLMs: prompting, evals, LLM-as-judge, or prototypes you vibe-coded yourself.
* Exposure to speech technology: speech recognition, text-to-speech, noise suppression, or telephony.
* You've worked closely with enterprise customers or with forward-deployed or solutions teams.

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

In your first year, success means:

* Callers on our largest deployments have measurably better conversations, tracked on metrics you defined.
* FDEs and customers can work out why a call went wrong in minutes, without pulling in engineering.
* Recurring call failures are caught before customers report them.
* Every in-call change ships with a metric, so we know whether it worked in production.
* You own the roadmap for both areas, so engineering time goes to the problems that matter most to customers, and everyone can see why.

**Why Bolna**
=============

* One of the fastest-moving teams in Voice AI in India
* Your problems come straight from live deployments at some of India's largest enterprises, and your fixes reach millions of calls
* Direct access to the founders, and daily work with engineering, ML and FDEs
* Build a rare skill set at the intersection of AI, speech, product and enterprise
* Competitive compensation + meaningful ESOPs
* Bengaluru office, in-person team collaboration

jobs.title: Product Manager (RASP)
jobs.description:
**About Bureau**

Bureau is a unified risk decisioning platform for Compliance, Fraud, and Transaction risks. Our platform is a single decision-making engine, powered by a 1 billion+ identity knowledge graph. Over 150 Banks, fintechs, retailers, and digital platforms use Bureau to verify identities faster and stop fraud earlier globally.

Bureau has raised $50M+ from renowned Silicon Valley and global investors including Sorenson Capital and PayPal Ventures and is expanding rapidly from APAC to Americas, Europe, and beyond.

**Why Bureau?**

Bureau is building the infrastructure that makes digital identities and transactions safe and trustworthy for billions of people. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is real.

We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, build systems from scratch, and care deeply about turning strategy into execution. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won't be your place. If you want to shape how a scaling global company operates—keep reading.

**About the Role: Product Manager - RASP**

You will own Bureau RASP (Runtime Application Self-Protection). It is a rare chance to take a category-defining security product from launch to scale.

* Sophisticated mobile fraud now executes inside the app itself. Bureau RASP answers with a four-layer Zero Trust framework embedded in the customer's app:
* Application integrity: code obfuscation, anti-tampering and anti-debugging, powered by XVM, our proprietary virtualization engine.
* Runtime and environment: detection of root, jailbreak, emulators, cloned apps, hooking and overlay attacks.
* Network and data channel: protection against MITM, packet sniffing, geo spoofing and VPN or proxy bypass.
* Visibility and policy: monitor, warn or block per threat from a dashboard, with immutable audit logs.

It is built at the OS level, goes live in minutes with no code changes, and feeds runtime signals into Bureau's Graph Identity Network. You will decide where it goes next.

**What you’ll be doing**

* Own the RASP vision, strategy and roadmap across Android and iOS.
* Track the mobile threat landscape and turn new attack patterns into shipped protections.
* Partner with security, SDK and platform engineers to deliver detections that are accurate, hard to bypass and light on app performance.
* Shape the customer experience: zero-code onboarding, the policy engine, alerts and audit reporting.
* Connect RASP signals with Device Intelligence, Behavioural Biometrics and the Graph Identity Network to create value no standalone RASP can match.
* Work with sales, solutions and marketing on positioning, pricing, demos and competitive wins.
* Spend time with CISOs, fraud heads and app teams at banks, fintechs and e-commerce firms to learn what they need.
* Define success metrics such as adoption, detection efficacy, false positives and integration time, and report on them.

**What You’ll Bring**

**Must have**

* 4-6 years in product management, with at least 2 years on a B2B security, fraud or mobile SDK product.
* Working knowledge of mobile app security: Android and iOS internals, reverse engineering, rooting, hooking and tampering.
* Comfort going deep with engineers on technical trade-offs, and going wide with customers on business outcomes.
* A record of taking a product from early release to enterprise adoption.
* Clear writing and sharp prioritisation.

**Good to have**

* Experience with RASP, app shielding, device fingerprinting or mobile threat defence.
* Exposure to BFSI or fintech customers and regulatory expectations for app security.
* An engineering or security research background.

**Our Culture**

* We hire self-motivated people and get out of their way
* We value performance, not hours worked
* Speed, ownership, and impact matter most

**Compensation**

* Competitive salary + potential equity
* Health benefits, flexible PTO, learning budget

jobs.description:
**Experience**
: 3.00 + years
  
  
**Salary**
: Confidential (based on experience)

**What do you need for this opportunity?
  
  
**Must have skills required:**

**Nubra is Looking for:******
**Job Description:**
**Nubra | Product Manager, Core Trading**
**Location:**
Bangalore
  
  
**Experience:**
3 to 6 years
  
  
**Type:**
Full-time
  
  
**Team:**
Product
  
  
**About Nubra:**
Nubra is a trading platform for people who take trading seriously, whether they scalp index options on expiry day or run multi-leg strategies over weeks. We've built Smart Flexi Orders, multi-strike charts, tick-level option chain data, a multi-leg strategy builder, smart watchlists, automation APIs, and flexible collateral management, and we're still early in what we want the product to become.
  
  
Most of our users have tried other platforms before us. They know exactly what breaks at 9:15 AM, which order types are missing, and how many taps it takes to adjust a position when the market moves against them. Our job is to make those moments better. You can see the product at nubra.io.
  
  
**The role:**
You'll own the roadmap for the parts of Nubra that traders use every single session: order placement and execution, the option chain, the strategy builder, charts, and our automation APIs. You'll work day to day with engineering and design, and closely with compliance and risk, since almost everything we ship has a regulatory angle. This is a hands-on role. You'll write the specs, sit in on technical discussions about latency and data feeds, look at the numbers yourself, and talk to traders every week.
  
  
Coming from e-commerce or D2C? We'd like to hear from you. Some of the best product thinking for a trading app comes from people who have built checkout flows, high-volume order systems, or products where a few seconds of delay costs real money. What we need from you is a genuine interest in markets and the willingness to get fluent in options and derivatives quickly. If you already trade on the side, even better.
  
  
**What you'll be responsible for:**- Roadmap and product direction:
- Own the roadmap for order types, option chain, strategy builder, charts and automation APIs.
- Decide what we build next and, just as often, what we don't. Be able to explain the reasoning to the team.
- Keep a close eye on other trading and investing platforms in India and abroad, and know where we're ahead and where we're behind.
- Building and shipping:
- Turn trader workflows into clear specs that engineers can build from without a dozen follow-up calls.
- Work with engineering on the trade-offs that matter in trading: speed, reliability, and accuracy of data under heavy market load.
- Work with design so that complex features (multi-leg orders, margin, Greeks) feel simple to use.
- Plan releases carefully. A bug in an order flow is not the same as a bug in a settings page.
- Users and data:

* Speak with active traders regularly through calls, support tickets, community channels and usage data.
* Define what success looks like for each feature and track adoption, retention, order success rates and trading behaviour.
* Run experiments where it makes sense and be honest about results when something doesn't work.
* Compliance and risk:

+ Work with compliance and risk teams so that new features meet SEBI and exchange requirements from day one, not as an afterthought.
+ Understand how margin, collateral and risk checks affect the user experience, and design around them sensibly.

**Your first six months, roughly:**

* Month 1: Use the product the way our users do, with real trades if you're comfortable. Read support tickets, sit with engineering, and get to know the order lifecycle end to end.
* Months 2 to 3: Take ownership of one feature area and ship your first meaningful improvement. Set up the metrics you'll use to judge it.
* Months 4 to 6: Own the roadmap for your area, with a clear view of priorities for the next two quarters and the user evidence to back them.

**What we're looking for:**

* 3 to 6 years of product management experience in trading, broking, fintech, capital markets, e-commerce or D2C.
* You've shipped consumer products end to end, ideally ones with high transaction volumes, real-time flows or demanding power users.
* You're comfortable with data. You can write or read a query, build a funnel, and tell the difference between a real trend and noise.
* You understand trading concepts such as order types, options, derivatives and market data, or you're clearly on your way there.
* You write clearly and can get engineering, design, compliance and business teams to agree on a plan.
* You're interested in markets. Not as a line on your CV, but because you actually find them interesting.

**Good to have:**

* Personal trading experience, especially in F&O.
* Prior work at a broker, exchange or prop trading firm.
* Experience with options or derivatives platforms specifically.
* Working knowledge of SEBI regulations and NSE/BSE rules.
* A background in analytics or quant, or experience with real-time data systems.
* Experience building payments, checkout or other high-trust flows where conversion and reliability both matter.

**How we work:**
We start with the user. Here that means thinking like a trader. If you can't explain why a trader would care, it probably doesn't belong on the roadmap. We move quickly. Markets change fast and so do our users' expectations. We'd rather ship, learn and fix than wait for a perfect version.
  
  
We use data, and we make calls. Numbers inform our decisions, but we don't hide behind them. Sometimes you have to back your judgement. We own outcomes. Shipping a feature isn't the finish line. Whether it helped traders is what counts.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Tokenisation & Stablecoin Infrastructure
jobs.description:
BitGo (NYSE: BTGO) is the digital asset infrastructure company delivering custody, wallets, staking, trading, financing, stablecoins, and settlement services from regulated cold storage. Since 2013, BitGo has focused on accelerating the transition of the financial system to a digital asset economy. BitGo maintains a global presence and multiple regulated entities, including BitGo Bank & Trust, National Association, the first federally chartered digital asset trust bank owned by a publicly traded company. Today, BitGo serves thousands of institutions, including many of the industry's top brands, financial institutions, exchanges, and platforms, and millions of investors worldwide. For more information, visit www.bitgo.com.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Product Manager to join our Tokenization & Stablecoin Infrastructure team and drive the products that let institutions issue, mint, redeem, custody, and move stablecoins and tokenized real-world assets. You will work closely with stablecoin issuers, asset managers, banks, and token foundations, along with engineering, compliance, legal, and go-to-market teams, to bring new issuers and assets onto BitGo's regulated infrastructure.
  
  
This is a high-ownership role in a fast-moving, ambiguous space where regulation, market structure, and technology are evolving together. You will own the roadmap, shape strategy, and see products through from first customer conversation to launch and scale.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own the roadmap, strategy, and execution for BitGo's tokenization and stablecoin infrastructure, including mint/burn and redemption flows, issuance workflows, reserve and settlement integrations, and tokenized asset lifecycle management.
* Lead and motivate a cross-functional team of engineers, designers, and operations and compliance partners to build institutional-grade solutions.
* Scope and ship new issuer and asset integrations end to end: write PRDs, define order, fee, and settlement flows, align on custody and security models, and drive launch readiness.
* Partner with stablecoin issuers, tokenized fund and asset managers, banks, and ecosystem and blockchain foundations to understand needs, shape partnerships, and turn them into scalable product capabilities rather than one-off builds.
* Work with compliance, legal, and risk teams to make sure every product meets regulatory, security, and licensing requirements across jurisdictions.
* Evaluate new chains, token standards, and market-structure developments (for example, tokenized securities, tokenized deposits, and onchain settlement) and turn them into a clear point of view and prioritized opportunities.
* Define and track success metrics such as issuer onboarding time, volumes, revenue, and reliability, and iterate based on data and client feedback.
* Work with GTM, sales, and client success teams on positioning, pricing, and client enablement, and act as a trusted product partner to key clients.
* Mentor junior PMs and help raise the bar for product craft within the team.

**Who Would Be a Great Fit**

* 5+ years of product management experience, ideally in fintech, payments, crypto, or financial infrastructure, with a record of shipping B2B or institutional products.
* Strong working knowledge of crypto and blockchain: token standards and mechanics, multiple L1/L2 ecosystems, wallets and custody, and onchain settlement.
* Understanding of stablecoin and tokenization models: issuance, mint/burn and redemption, reserves, fiat on/off-ramps, and how tokenized funds, securities, or deposits work.
* Familiarity with the regulatory landscape for stablecoins and digital assets (such as GENIUS Act, MiCA, and trust-bank or custody regulation) and the ability to work through it with legal and compliance partners.
* Experience leading cross-functional teams, with the ability to coordinate engineering, business, and external partners and to build consensus in ambiguous areas.
* Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to write clear PRDs and explain complex technical or regulatory topics to executives and clients.
* Comfort in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, balancing several projects with different priorities and a hands-on approach to execution.
* Prior startup or scale-up experience, showing adaptability, ownership, and sound judgment.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in traditional finance, capital markets, asset management, or banking infrastructure (custody, settlement, transfer agency).
* Hands-on exposure to institutional tokenization networks or permissioned chains.
* Technical background or comfort reading APIs, smart contracts, and architecture docs.
* Experience with enterprise partnerships and client-facing product work.

**Why Join BitGo?**
Disrupting an industry takes vision, innovation, passion, technical chops, drive to deliver, collaboration, and execution. Join a team of great people who strive for excellence and personify our corporate values of open communication, collaboration, accountability, craftsmanship, and a client first approach. We are looking for new colleagues who bring innovative ways of thinking and problem solving, and who want to be part of the team that changes the world's financial markets.
  
  
Here are some of the benefits of working at BitGo:
  
  

* Competitive salary
* IT equipment support for work
* Meal & commute allowance
* Medical insurance
* Attractive well-being allowance (covering medical, wellness, and fitness)
* Snacks on the house in the Bangalore office
* A great, talented workforce to learn and grow with

Cryptocurrencies are the most disruptive change the financial services industry has seen in years. Join us and you'll be able to look back and say you were part of the team that transformed finance.
  
  
**Note:**
This role requires working onsite (Monday to Friday) at the Bangalore office.

jobs.description:
The Nasdaq Data Platform & Operations Product team is looking for a passionate Specialist, Product Delivery Specialist (Product Owner) with a focus on product execution (creation and execution of a SaaS product backlog), to join the Bangalore technology center in India. If Innovation and effectiveness drive you forward this is the place for you!
  
  
Nasdaq is continuously revolutionizing markets and undergoing transformations while we adopt new technologies to develop innovative solutions, constantly aiming to rewrite tomorrow. As a Product Delivery Specialist, you will play a key role in the creation and delivery of the CAP data platform and will join us in advancing Nasdaq’s purpose to advance economic progress for all.
  
  
We are now looking for a exceptional team member in our Bangalore office to partner directly with our Technology colleagues in the evolution of our product suite. You will be responsible for defining and driving the execution of relevant product initiatives for one or two permanent development teams in Bangalore.
  
  
We are looking for candidates who share those values along with a genuine desire and drive to deliver top technology solutions to today's markets.
  
  
With this position we offer :
  
  
Join the Product organization within Nasdaq’s Data Platform & Operations Team. The main objective of our team is to deliver the foundational components of a new common data platform to integreate Nasdaq’s Capital Access Platform division. As our new member, you will work with a group of enthusiastic and experienced team members and colleagues. Together with your team, you will be responsible for delivery and support of product enhancements for our data platform foundation.

We are seeking a Product Owner at Senior Consultant rank to drive the execution of digital products and platforms by translating business needs into clear, actionable and value-driven product requirements. The role requires strong product ownership, backlog management, agile delivery and stakeholder collaboration skills, with the ability to connect product decisions to measurable business value, outcomes and benefits realization. The core focus of the role remains Product Management—owning the product backlog, shaping user-centric requirements, enabling agile delivery and supporting adoption—while bringing practical exposure to value management concepts such as value cases, KPI definition, outcome tracking, prioritization by value and continuous value realization. jobs.title: Associate Manager, Product-Tech, Central
jobs.description:
**About The/Nudge Institute**
**The/Nudge**
is an action institute building resilient livelihoods to alleviate poverty. We work with women, farmers, tribals, and youth across rural development, agriculture, skilling, and economic inclusion, in partnership with 15+ central and state governments.
  
  
Our economic inclusion journey towards serving 25 million Indians spans 10 states and currently reaches over 1.5 million people. Through our incubator, accelerator, and grand challenges, we have supported 200+ social entrepreneurs, including Forbes 30 Under 30 honorees, Earthshot Prize winners, and nationally recognized changemakers.
  
  
Founded with the support of 130+ eminent philanthropists, 40+ corporates, and 15+ foundations, The/Nudge is working towards a poverty-free India, within our lifetime.
  
  
**About This Role**
The/Nudge is building its own technology products to run the organisation better and to deliver programmes at scale. These include internal platforms our 400+ team members use day to day, and tools that support our programme and field teams. We build fast and in-house, using AI-assisted development tools and LLMs.
  
  
We are looking for an Associate Product Manager to own products end to end: from understanding what users need, to shaping the solution, shipping it, and driving adoption. You will work closely with leadership, programme teams, strategy and operations teams, and with the engineers who build our products. This role suits someone who wants hands-on product ownership early in their career, in an organisation where technology directly serves social impact.
  
  
**What will you do?**

* Discover the problem: Work with internal teams and end users to understand their workflows and pain points through interviews, observation, feedback and usage data. Turn what you learn into clear problem statements.
* Define the product: Write product requirement documents (PRDs), user stories and acceptance criteria. Make sure every feature has a clear purpose, scope and measure of success.
* Prioritise the roadmap: Maintain the product backlog and roadmap. Weigh user impact, effort, risk and organisational priorities, and explain trade-offs clearly to stakeholders.
* Build with engineering and AI: Work hands-on with developers, interns and AI-assisted development tools to design, build and iterate on features. Translate requirements into precise, well-scoped instructions.
* Test before release: Plan and run user acceptance testing, coordinate beta testers, and track bugs and fixes through to closure. Protect live products from regressions.
* Launch and drive adoption: Plan rollouts, write launch communications, run demos and training sessions, and create user guides so that products are actually used.
* Measure what matters: Define and track product metrics such as adoption, usage and user satisfaction. Use the data to decide what to build, fix or retire next.
* Keep things documented: Maintain product documentation, decision logs and release notes so the products can scale and be handed over smoothly.
* Grow the product practice: Help bring a product-first, AI-first way of working to new initiatives as The/Nudge builds more products in the future.

**Who are we looking for in this role?**

* A degree in engineering, computer science, business, economics or a related field. Strong candidates from other backgrounds who can show product thinking are welcome to apply.
* 5+ years of overall experience in product management, business analysis, consulting, technology implementation or software engineering. Experience shipping a product or feature that real users adopted is a strong plus.
* Clear structured thinking: the ability to break a messy problem into its parts and write it up crisply.
* Comfort with data: spreadsheets are a must; basic SQL or a dashboarding tool is a strong plus.
* Hands-on familiarity with AI tools and large language models (LLMs), and curiosity about how they can be used to build products faster.
* Enough technical understanding to work confidently with engineers: how web apps, databases and APIs fit together. You do not need to be a developer.
* Excellent communication with non-technical users, from senior leadership to field teams. You can explain a feature simply and listen well to feedback.
* An ownership mindset: you follow a feature through to adoption, not just to release.
* A strong alignment with our mission to leverage technology for large-scale social impact.

**Good To Have**

* Experience building with no-code, low-code or AI-assisted development tools.
* Exposure to internal tools, ERP, CRM or HRMS systems.
* Experience in the social sector, or working with government or field programmes.

***Please note:***
This is an onsite, full-time role based in our Bengaluru office. We are dedicated to building a dynamic in-office culture and require all team members to work from the office.
  
  
*We aspire to be an inclusive and diverse organisation and encourage qualified individuals irrespective of their religion, caste, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, or any other dimension of identity, to apply.*

You will collaborate with product management to align solutions with market and customer demand. You will be responsible for mitigating technical risks associated with new product development and providing rapid issue resolutions to minimize disruption. jobs.title: Executive Product Owner - Enterprise Knowledge
jobs.description:
**Organization:**
At CommBank, we never lose sight of the role we play in other people’s financial wellbeing. Our focus is to help people and businesses move forward to progress. To make the right financial decisions and achieve their dreams, targets, and aspirations. Regardless of where you work within our organisation, your initiative, talent, ideas, and energy all contribute to the impact that we can make with our work. Together we can achieve great things.
  
  
**Job Title:**
Executive Product Owner - Enterprise Knowledge
  
  
**Location:**
Bangalore
  
  
**Business & Team:**
The Enterprise Knowledge Domain is a newly established capability and a foundational pillar of the Group's artificial intelligence strategy. The team will define how organisational knowledge is structured, governed, connected and made available across the enterprise. It will work closely with engineering, architecture, data, scientific and business communities to create trusted knowledge foundations that support enterprise search, knowledge discovery and intelligent systems.
  
  
Within the domain, the Knowledge Fabric team builds and operates the federated context layer that connects these foundations to people and AI agents, and the Product Owner makes sure it is adopted and delivers value.
  
  
**Impact and Contribution:**
As Exec Product Owner for the Knowledge Fabric, you will own the fabric as a platform product. You will set the roadmap and prioritise the backlog across the context layer, retrieval and MCP services, knowledge controls, and the consumption experience for AI agents and the harnesses they run in, including Agents.CBA, CommbankOS, Microsoft Copilot Cowork and OpenAI Codex.
  
  
You will onboard the teams building enterprise agents, user agents and user-defined agents, and make sure the fabric meets their needs for relevance, speed, security and cost. You will define and track platform measures such as retrieval latency, relevance, token cost and entitlement conformance, and coordinate closely with the Chief Data Office, Chief AI Office and End User Experience teams to bring use cases and domains live on the Knowledge Fabric.
  
  
**You are a platform product leader who can make a complex technical capability simple, valuable and easy for other teams to adopt.**
The Knowledge Fabric is building world-leading knowledge management capabilities for our AI-powered colleagues and agents. Together, we will make trusted, permission-aware knowledge available to the AI agents that need it, through a single, consistent retrieval point.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Own the product vision, roadmap and prioritised backlog for the Knowledge Fabric platform. Drive product exploration (e.g. using design thinking and analytics) and formulate hypotheses to validate product strategy / design.
* Translate consumer and architecture needs into clear features and acceptance criteria for the context layer, retrieval and MCP services, and knowledge controls.
* Accountable for end-to-end value delivery and product lifecycle management (including managing requirements lifecycle, production deployment and release day coordination and sign off).
* Assess and implement build vs buy decisions to enable platform and capability build
* Act as the voice of the customer and business and translate this for the squad. Apply expertise to support prioritisation, balance trade-offs, and explore strategies to successfully achieve business and customer outcomes.
* Lead the onboarding of consuming agent teams across multiple harnesses, with clear documentation, service expectations and support.
* Define and report platform KPIs, including latency, relevance, token cost, availability and entitlement conformance.
* Work with the Chief Engineer to balance new capability, reliability, security and technical debt.
* Ensure entitlements, fine-grained permissions and agent-specific access controls are reflected in product requirements and evidenced for risk stakeholders.
* Coordinate roadmaps and dependencies with the Chief Data Office, Chief AI Office, End User Experience and the Knowledge Domain products.
* Track and report progress in bringing use cases and domains live on the Knowledge Fabric. Manage the squad’s performance to defined objectives including OKR tracking, etc.
* Ensure all obligations across customer, regulatory, internal policy and process frameworks (e.g. GDF, PDDP, RiC) are fully met and satisfied. Identify, articulate and manage risks, dependencies and compliance across streams of work (e.g. customer propositions).

**Essential Skills:**

* Have owned technical platform, API or data products used by other engineering teams.

The role partners closely with the digital team, People Analytics and HR leaders to design, configure and scale listening programs across the employee lifecycle, drives simplification and standardization of processes, and benchmarks market best practices to recommend improvements that turn employee feedback into meaningful action.
  
  
What will you do?

-------------------

**About the Role**

The Business Process Analyst is responsible for executing defined business processes and day-to-day workflows in line with client instructions and standard operating procedures (SOPs). The role focuses on accurate data processing, transaction management, and documentation review while meeting turnaround times, service-level agreements (SLAs), and productivity and quality targets. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, communicates effectively, and can work with minimal supervision in a fast-paced, 24/7 environment.

**Responsibilities**

* Respond professionally to common customer inquiries and requests.
* Participate in team meetings and required training sessions.

**Looking For**

* Candidates who can follow defined instructions and execute business processes accurately and consistently.
* Individuals who are well organized, deadline-driven, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.

**Mandatory Skills**

**A. Technical / Functional Skills**

* Excellent communication skills in English, both spoken and written.
* Typing speed of at least 35 wpm with 100% accuracy.
* Ability to follow instructions, predefined workflows, and SOPs.
* Strong attention to detail to maintain data accuracy, completeness, and consistency.
* Ability to maintain accurate trackers and logs and meet turnaround times and SLA requirements.

**B. Soft Skills**

* Self-motivation and the ability to work with minimal supervision.
* Strong interpersonal skills and clear communication with team leads and supervisors.
* Strong organizational skills and a commitment to meeting deadlines.

Leads the analysis, design, and continuous improvement of business processes leveraging the ServiceNow platform, aligning technology capabilities with strategic business objectives. Engages with cross-functional stakeholders to elicit, analyze, and translate complex business requirements into scalable, high-quality solutions. Drives process optimization through detailed as-is/to-be analysis, gap assessments, and implementation of industry and ServiceNow best practices, including ITIL-aligned processes. [velvetjobs.com], [torchora.com]
  
  
Serves as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and technical delivery teams, ensuring requirements are clearly defined, documented, and prioritized. Develops comprehensive artifacts including business requirements, functional specifications, process flows, and user stories with well-defined acceptance criteria. Collaborates closely with developers, architects, and product owners to support solution design, ensure alignment with requirements, and maintain traceability across the software development lifecycle, including testing (UAT), defect resolution, and deployment.
  
  
Supports release planning, change management, and user adoption activities through effective communication, training, and documentation. Identifies opportunities for automation, efficiency gains, and continuous improvement, contributing to overall process transformation and operational excellence initiatives.
  
  
Typically requires a bachelor’s degree and 5–8 years of relevant experience (or equivalent combination), with strong functional expertise in ServiceNow and experience working in Agile delivery environments. ServiceNow and ITIL certifications are preferred.
  
  
Applies advanced professional knowledge to independently manage moderately complex initiatives, provide guidance and mentorship to junior analysts, and contribute to broader transformation programs. Operates with limited oversight and typically reports to a Manager.

We will recruit, hire, promote, transfer and provide opportunities for advancement based on individual qualifications and job performance in all matters affecting employment, compensation, benefits, working conditions, and opportunities for advancement. jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst - Securities Services
jobs.description:
**Some Careers Shine Brighter Than Others.**
If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
**Senior Business Analyst - Securities Services**
**In This Role, You Will**

* The Product Solutions Team is a global function (~200+ FTE) supporting all Securities Services (SSv) products, accountable for product/service programme governance, design, delivery and operating model oversight aligned to strategy and targets.
* The Senior Business Analyst focuses on evaluating and optimising processes to improve efficiency, client outcomes and deliver strategic, scalable, reusable solutions.
* Works closely with Operations, Product and Technology to identify improvement opportunities, document requirements, mitigate risks, and validate/realise benefits.
* Owns the Business Analysis component of Product Solutions projects from initiation to delivery, partnering with Project/Programme Managers, workstream leads and other BAs.
* Leads change management activities end-to-end: change planning, stakeholder/audience analysis, communications, training/support, organisation alignment, and tracking readiness/adoption/feedback.
* Responsible for implementation management, including planning, controlling and reporting deployment activities to accelerate benefits and minimise risk; manages implementation readiness.
* May also deliver project management for smaller change initiatives or a workstream within a larger programme, alongside BA responsibilities.
* Core BA duties include requirements elicitation (interviews, workshops, surveys, process analysis, use cases), reconciling conflicting inputs, translating needs into operational requirements, and challenging assumptions.
* Produce required governance artefacts and supports architectural standards, best practices and documentation; identifies process gaps, performance bottlenecks and sustainability risks; participates in enterprise risk assessments and compliance monitoring.

**To Be Successful, You Will**

* Demonstrate experience in business analysis roles or equivalent experience in large scale operational change. Excellent analytical skills and strategic business insight to understand complex challenges and facilitate workable solutions.
* Proven ability to influence, negotiate and build relationships with stakeholders at all levels across cross-geographical teams.
* Competent in Operating Model Design, Data Analysis, User Documentation, Solution Design, Solution Validation and Root Cause Analysis.
* Proficient in Impact Assessment/Gap Analysis, Business Requirements gathering, Process Mapping and Process Design
* Excellent oral and written communication skills and experience interfacing with both business and IT stakeholders at all levels.
* Ability to demonstrate what is important in ensuring successful delivery of projects across various phases and the ability to flex your approach to the different challenges faced.
* Exposure to different project/portfolio types/clients – ideally with experience of complex business and IT transformation.
* Sufficient level of technical background to provide high credibility of knowledge to teams and to be able to evaluate complex project / portfolio risks and issues accurately and objectively.
* Hands on knowledge of using project management tools (e.g – Visio, Project Planner, JIRA, Confluence, etc). Utilise experience in using enterprise-wide requirements definition and management systems and methodologies required.

**You’ll achieve more at HSBC**
www.hsbc.com/careers
  
  
HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.”
  
  
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

jobs.title: Business Analyst – JDE Finance
jobs.description:
**Date Posted:**
2026-11-03
  
  
**Country:**
India
  
  
**Location:**
1st Floor, Embassy Vajram Onyx, Embassy Tech Village, Outer Ring Road, Devarabisanahalli, Bengaluru, Karnataka - 560103, India.
  
  
**Job Title:**
Business Analyst – JDE Finance
  
  
Years of Experience: 8+
  
  
**Role Overview:**
Otis has established a global ERP model built in JD Edwards (currently JDE 9.2) and is actively rolling it out to all Otis global locations by 2026. There is a US based program team managing the deployments, support, and enhancements of the global model. Otis is currently leveraging multiple India based partners for the deployments and ongoing build efforts of the global model. Otis has setup a Global Finance Service Center in Bangalore (OGSC), India, and is now looking to expand that facility to hire Otis IT employees to support the JDE Global Program.
  
  
The Business Analyst will assist the US Based Solution Architect in supporting, implementing, and building new functionality within the JD Edwards module.
  
  
**On a typical day you will:**

* Assist the Solution Architect Finance and Senior Manager GJDE Finance in improving the Global Model and enforcing compliance across global locations
* Assess Change Requests and make recommendations on fit/gap analysis
* Perform functional design, create specifications, coordinate work with developers, and perform end to end testing
* Collaborate with internal and outsourced partner resources in all phases of software development lifecycle
* Work with Solution Architect on process changes and workarounds to avoid gaps & reduce Change Requests
* Analyze and suggest resolution for critical issues from sites live on JDE
* Work closely with World Head Quarter (WHQ) team to keep informed of upcoming projects & functionality that may impact projects & development efforts.
* Work closely with development team to drive standardization
* Must be detail oriented with a strong analytical background to perform preliminary functional testing.
* Able to coordinate as well as demo and train JDE functional solutions to new sites and Business Users
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
* Ability to achieve results in a dynamic and demanding environment within Cost and time
* Ability to communicate well with all levels of employees
* Demonstrates the highest ethical standards
* Take Ownership of the work he/she does.
* Work Independently with less handholding.
* Being Pro-active and taking up critical requests and start to provide solutions.
* Work on large projects and deliver on time and Cost
* Being methodical and keep track of the activities and documenting them and share to the team and upload them to a central location.
* Proper knowledge Transfer to the Team and other stake holders as when Solution is deployed to Production.
* Well and timely communication of status of the work to the relevant stakeholders.
* Work as a team and contribute towards the Team.

**What you will need to be succssfull:**

* 8+ years of in-depth knowledge and understanding of the JDE Finance Module (AP,AR,GL&FA Modules)
* Strong Knowledge on Interfaces to Finance Module
* 10+ years overall IT experience in the Finance domain
* Basic Accounting knowledge
* Excellent organizational, time management and customer service skills
* Excellent written and oral communication skills
* Strong knowledge in Software development life cycle process (SDLC)
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft suite, including PowerPoint
* Knowledge of security, configuring and set ups within JDE
* Knowledge of P2P and O2C Process in JDE
* Knowledge of Job Cost module, not mandatory
* Knowledge of Scheduler Jobs in JDE
* Experience working closely with a diverse development team
* Experience with functional specifications design and review for JDE programs and ability to communicate development efforts
* Experience working on international projects with a global team
* Co-ordinate with Vendors and partners in developing solutions
* Work closely with implementation team to get the requirements in place

If you live in a city, chances are we will give you a lift or play a role in keeping you moving every day.
  
  
Otis is the world’s leading elevator and escalator manufacturing, installation, and service company. We move 2.4 billion people every day and maintain approximately 2.4 million customer units worldwide, the industry's largest Service portfolio.
  
  
You may recognize our products in some of the world’s most famous landmarks including the Eiffel Tower, Empire State Building, Burj Khalifa and the Petronas Twin Towers! We are 72,000 people strong, including engineers, digital technology experts, sales, and functional specialists, as well as factory and field technicians, all committed to meeting the diverse needs of our customers and passengers in more than 200 countries and territories worldwide. We are proud to be a diverse, global team with a proven legacy of innovation that continues to be the bedrock of a fast-moving, high-performance company.
  
  
When you join Otis, you become part of an innovative global industry leader with a resilient business model. You’ll belong to a diverse, trusted, and caring community where your contributions, and the skills and capabilities you’ll gain working alongside the best and brightest, keep us connected and on the cutting edge.
  
  
We provide opportunities, training, and resources, that build leadership and capabilities in Sales, Field, Engineering and Major Projects and our Employee Scholar Program is a notable point of pride, through which Otis sponsors colleagues to pursue degrees or certification programs.
  
  
Today, our focus more than ever is on people. As a global, people-powered company, we put people – passengers, customers, and colleagues – at the center of everything we do. jobs.title: Business  Analyst –  Liquidity Management, BFS Consulting
jobs.description:
**Job Description: Senior Business Analyst – Liquidity Management**
**Location**
: Bangalore/Chennai
  
  
**Notice**
: Immediate to 60 days
  
  
**Experience**
: 9 to 13 years
  
  
**Domain**
: Liquidity Risk
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Senior Business Analyst with Liquidity Management will serve as a hands-on subject matter expert within the Treasury Technology team. This role focuses on designing, implementing, and enhancing capital and liquidity management solutions. The candidate must possess strong analytical, technical, and stakeholder management skills and thrive in an agile delivery environment.
  
  
Domain Expertise (Mandatory)
  
  

* Treasury & Balance Sheet Management
* Asset and Liability Management (ALM)
* Liquidity Risk Management including:

+ Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR)
+ Net Stable Funding Ratio (NSFR)
+ High-Quality Liquid Assets (HQLA)

* Intraday Liquidity & Cash Flow Management
* Funding Liquidity Risk (Short-Term & Long-Term)
* Funds Transfer Pricing (FTP)
* Cash Management & Accounting
* Trade settlement lifecycle with strong exposure to SWIFT

**Good To Have**

* Interest Rate Risk in Banking Book (IRRBB)
* Capital or Credit Calculation Engines
* Axiom (Capital Reporting tool)

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Translate capital and liquidity management business rules into detailed technology requirements, including mappings, controls, and traceability matrices
* Author user stories and define acceptance criteria using JIRA and Confluence
* Develop and maintain data lineage, data catalogues, and governance documentation for audit and compliance
* Conduct data discovery, profiling, and validation to ensure data quality and integrity
* Create test plans, test cases, and lead QA/testing and triage activities
* Perform hands-on work with data integration, platforms, and large datasets
* Design data and process flow diagrams using tools such as Visio and Confluence
* Apply strong SQL skills for querying and analysing complex datasets
* Maintain strong understanding of financial products and their impact on capital and liquidity management

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Translating business requirements into technical specifications
* Data integration, testing, and documentation
* Strong expertise in SQL and data analysis across large datasets
* Solid understanding of capital and liquidity management frameworks
* Experience in the full trade lifecycle and SWIFT messaging
* Experience in creating data flows, process diagrams, and governance artefacts
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, or related field (Advanced degree preferred)
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills

Nice-to-Have
  
  

* Experience in treasury systems or capital management technology
* Familiarity with big data concepts and platforms
* Experience with regulatory reporting tools (e.g., Axiom)

Interested candidates kindly send your resume to mithra.umapathy@cognizant.com and AthiAravinthkumar.Selvappandi@cognizant.com
